name: Transgression on the action bar is saved as Blood Curse (#5469)
contract: AscensionCompatData::TalentReplacements (AscensionTalentReplacementData.h:54) carries {20, 26, 504728, 562720, {{801076 at 0}}}: in Sanguine specialization 26, knowing the Transgression talent 504728 turns Blood Curse 562720 into Transgression 801076. AscensionClassService::SynchronizeTalentReplacements (AscensionCompat.cpp:884-953), run from OnPlayerLearnSpell (AscensionCompat.cpp:5782-5784) when Blood Curse or the talent is learned, teaches 801076 with learnSpell(801076, true) (AscensionCompat.cpp:945), so it is a temporary spell never written to character_spell, and registers it over Blood Curse with Player::SetTemporarySpellReplacement (AscensionCompat.cpp:951). The #5469 server log drops a Transgression button at login: Player::_SaveActions wrote 801076 and Player::_LoadActions runs before the class service teaches it again. persisted_action_button reads Player::GetSavedActionButtonSpell, the id _SaveActions writes. A button holding Transgression must be saved as Blood Curse; a button holding Blood Curse is saved unchanged. With CoA.TemporarySpellReplacement.Silent the swap-in and the swap-out of Transgression print no chat line and the client keeps the replacement after the server drops it.
